column1: # Claude Code 2.1.323's documented environment variables: NAME<TAB>category<TAB>description.
# and settings pages). Generated once from the research catalogue and kept as data; the names
# claudio refuses (app::env) are left out. Descriptions are cut at 160 characters.

column3: API key sent as X-Api-Key header. When set, this key is used instead of your Claude Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, or Enterprise subscription even if you are logged in.
Custom value for the Authorization header (the value you set here will be prefixed with Bearer)
Workspace API key for Claude Platform on AWS, generated in the AWS Console. Sent as x-api-key and takes precedence over AWS SigV4
Override the Claude Platform on AWS endpoint URL. Use for custom regions or when routing through an LLM gateway.
Required for Claude Platform on AWS. Sent on every request as the anthropic-workspace-id header
Override the API endpoint to route requests through a proxy or gateway.
Override the Amazon Bedrock endpoint URL. Use for custom Amazon Bedrock endpoints or when routing through an LLM gateway. See Amazon Bedrock
Override the Amazon Bedrock Mantle endpoint URL. See Mantle endpoint
Cross-region inference profile prefix (us, eu, apac, jp, au, or global) Claude Code tries first instead of the one derived from the AWS region.
Amazon Bedrock service tier (default, flex, or priority). See Amazon Bedrock
Comma-separated list of additional anthropic-beta header values to include in API requests.
Custom headers to add to requests (Name: Value format, newline-separated for multiple headers).
Model ID to add as a custom entry in the /model picker. Use this to make a non-standard or gateway-specific model selectable without replacing built-in aliases.
Display description for the custom model entry in the /model picker. Defaults to Custom model (<model-id>) when not set
Display name for the custom model entry in the /model picker.
Comma-separated list of capabilities the custom model supports, for example effort,thinking. See Model configuration
Model ID that the fable alias resolves to, and the ID Claude Code recognizes as a Fable model for automatic model fallback on third-party providers.
Display description for the pinned Fable model in the /model picker. When not set, the row shows a default description that begins Custom Fable model.
Display name for the pinned Fable model in the /model picker.
Comma-separated list of capabilities the pinned Fable model supports, for example effort,thinking. See Model configuration
Model ID that the haiku alias resolves to, also used for background functionality. See Model configuration
Display description for the pinned Haiku model in the /model picker. When not set, the row shows a default description that begins Custom Haiku model.
Display name for the pinned Haiku model in the /model picker.
Comma-separated list of capabilities the pinned Haiku model supports, for example effort,thinking. See Model configuration
Model that new sessions start on by default. Requires Claude Code v2.1.236 or later. See Set a default model for new sessions
Model ID that the opus alias resolves to, and that opusplan uses while Plan Mode is active. See Model configuration
Display description for the pinned Opus model in the /model picker. When not set, the row shows a default description that begins Custom Opus model.
Display name for the pinned Opus model in the /model picker.
Comma-separated list of capabilities the pinned Opus model supports, for example effort,thinking. See Model configuration
Model ID that the sonnet alias resolves to, and that opusplan uses when Plan Mode is not active. See Model configuration
Display description for the pinned Sonnet model in the /model picker. When not set, the row shows a default description that begins Custom Sonnet model.
Display name for the pinned Sonnet model in the /model picker.
Comma-separated list of capabilities the pinned Sonnet model supports, for example effort,thinking. See Model configuration
Federation rule ID for Workload Identity Federation.
API key for Microsoft Foundry authentication (see Microsoft Foundry)
Bearer token for Microsoft Foundry authentication, such as a Microsoft Entra access token. Claude Code sends it as the Authorization: Bearer header.
Full base URL for the Microsoft Foundry resource (for example, https://my-resource.services.ai.azure.com/anthropic).
Microsoft Foundry resource name (for example, my-resource). Claude Code refuses a URL or host name.
Override the Claude Models on Google Cloud (Anthropic managed) endpoint URL, for example when routing through an LLM gateway
Google Cloud location that Claude Code puts in the Claude Models on Google Cloud (Anthropic managed) request URL. Defaults to global
Google Cloud project ID for Claude Models on Google Cloud (Anthropic managed)
Workspace ID for Claude Models on Google Cloud (Anthropic managed). Required, unless you’re on v2.1.307 or later and ANTHROPIC_GOOGLE_CLOUD_BASE_URL is set
Name of the model setting to use (see Model Configuration)
Organization ID for Workload Identity Federation. Set it together with ANTHROPIC_FEDERATION_RULE_ID. See authentication precedence
Name of the Anthropic profile to authenticate with, such as one created by ant auth login or by signing in to a Console account without an API key.
[DEPRECATED] Name of Haiku-class model for background tasks
Override AWS region for the Haiku-class model when using Amazon Bedrock or Amazon Bedrock Mantle.
Override Google Cloud’s Agent Platform endpoint URL. Use for custom Google Cloud’s Agent Platform endpoints or when routing through an LLM gateway.
GCP project ID that Google Cloud’s Agent Platform requests are addressed to. See Configure GCP credentials
Workspace ID for workload identity federation.
Override the 5-minute body idle timeout that aborts a streaming model response when no bytes arrive.
Time in milliseconds that each API request attempt has to receive its response headers. It doesn’t limit how long a streaming response runs after that.
Amazon Bedrock API key for authentication (see Amazon Bedrock API keys)
Default timeout for a foreground Bash or PowerShell tool command, in milliseconds (default: 120000, or 2 minutes).
Maximum number of characters of bash output that Claude Code reads back into a command’s result (default: 30000; maximum: 150000).
Maximum timeout the model can set for a foreground Bash or PowerShell tool command, in milliseconds (default: 600000, or 10 minutes).
OTLP/HTTP endpoint for detailed beta tracing: with ENABLE_BETA_TRACING_DETAILED=1, logs and traces go there instead of to the configured exporters.
Set to 1 to force claude --cloud to bundle and upload your local repository instead of cloning from its remote
Set to 1 to disable all built-in subagent types such as Explore and Plan. Only applies in non-interactive mode (the -p flag).
Set to 1 to skip the mcp__<server>__ prefix on tool names from SDK-created MCP servers. Tools use their original names. SDK usage only
Stall timeout in milliseconds for subagents. Also covers workflow agents on Claude Code v2.1.286 or later.
Set the percentage (1-100) of the auto-compact window at which auto-compaction triggers.
Set to 1 to force-enable automatic backgrounding of long-running agent tasks.
In screen reader mode, how many milliseconds Claude Code waits before it writes a new or changed line. Default 0, so Claude Code doesn’t wait.
Set to 1 to render screen-reader friendly output: flat text without decorative borders or animations.
In screen reader mode, how many milliseconds Claude Code holds the first interface render after the startup confirmation line.
Return to the original working directory after each Bash or PowerShell command in the main session
Timeout in milliseconds for the byte-level streaming idle watchdog; when set, it takes precedence over CLAUDE_STREAM_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS for that watchdog and…
Path to a file that an external tool, such as a screen-lock listener, creates when you unlock your screen and deletes when you lock it.
Set to 1 to keep the native terminal cursor visible and disable the inverted-text cursor indicator.
Set to 1 to load memory files from directories specified with --add-dir. Loads CLAUDE.md, .claude/CLAUDE.md, .claude/rules/*.md, and CLAUDE.local.md.
Set to 1 to repaint the entire screen on every frame in fullscreen rendering instead of sending incremental updates.
Set to 1 to send the effort parameter with every request, even when Claude Code does not recognize the model ID as effort-capable.
Interval in milliseconds at which credentials should be refreshed (when using apiKeyHelper)
Set to 0 to stop Claude Code from opening the browser automatically when a new artifact is published
Set to 0 to stop Claude reading and replying to comments on an artifact. Has no effect when CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC has turned artifacts off.
Set to 0 to stop Claude replying on its own to comments sent to it. Requires Claude Code v2.1.228 or later
Set to 0 to stop Claude from applying small changes to an artifact’s file as part of publishing it.
Set to 0 to omit the attribution block, which carries the client version and a prompt fingerprint, from the start of the system prompt.
Automount root folders for Claude Code to skip when it looks in the folders above your working directory for files such as CLAUDE.md, skills, and .mcp.json.
Removed in v2.1.283. Use CLAUDE_CODE_WORKER_CHECKIN_SCHEDULE instead
Set the auto-compact window, how full the context gets before compaction, from 100000 to 1000000 tokens. Suffixed values such as 200k require v2.1.304 or later.
Override automatic IDE connection. By default, Claude Code connects automatically when launched inside a supported IDE’s integrated terminal.
Sets the model for the classifier requests Claude Code sends in auto mode. Use a full model ID such as claude-sonnet-4-6.
Controls whether Claude Code asks the server to review auto mode actions. Set to 0 to use Claude Code’s own classifier requests instead.
Time in milliseconds Claude Code waits for the AWS default credential provider chain to produce credentials before the request fails with AWS default-chain…
Set to 0 to turn off the diff of the files that changed while a Bash command ran, or 1 to record it in every permission mode.
Set to 0 to make a non-interactive session report an idle status to its host at every turn end, even while background work is still running.
Set automatically in Bash tool and hook command subprocesses while the session has an active Remote Control connection, and removed when the connection ends.
Set to 0 to make Claude Code read the 0x08 byte, also written ^H, as plain Backspace, or 1 to read it as Ctrl+Backspace.
Comma-separated list of CA certificate sources for TLS connections. bundled is the Mozilla CA set shipped with Claude Code.
Path to client certificate file for mTLS authentication
Path to client private key file for mTLS authentication
Passphrase for encrypted CLAUDE_CODE_CLIENT_KEY (optional)
Milliseconds that a command adding or removing a user or local scope MCP server, such as claude mcp add, keeps trying for the lock on ~/.claude.json before it…
Removed in v2.1.186 and now a no-op. Previously set a separate timeout for the connect, TLS, and response-header phase of a streaming API request.
Override the debug log file path. Despite the name, this is a file path, not a directory.
Minimum log level written to the debug log file. Values: verbose, debug (default), info, warn, error.
Set to 1 to turn off 1M context window support.
Set to 1 to disable adaptive reasoning on Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 and fall back to the fixed thinking budget controlled by MAX_THINKING_TOKENS.
Set to 1 to disable the advisor tool.
Set to 1 to turn off background agents and agent view: claude agents, --bg, /background, and the on-demand supervisor.
Set to 1 to disable fullscreen rendering and use the classic main-screen renderer.
Set to 1 to turn off the Artifact tool, which publishes session output as a private web page on claude.ai.
Set to 1 to disable attachment processing. File mentions with @ syntax are sent as plain text instead of being expanded into file content.
Set to 1 to make a Claude Code process run its gcpAuthRefresh or awsAuthRefresh command itself instead of waiting while another process runs it.
Set to 1 to disable auto memory. Set to 0 to force auto memory on even when --bare mode or autoMemoryEnabled: false would otherwise disable it.
Set to 1 to remove the run_in_background parameter from the Bash, PowerShell, and subagent tools and to turn off the Ctrl+B shortcut and background runs of…
Set to 1 to stop Claude Code from treating an Amazon Bedrock streaming response with a missing or empty Content-Type header as Amazon Bedrock’s binary event…
Set to 1 to skip the check that an Amazon Bedrock streaming response carries the application/vnd.amazon.eventstream content-type.
Set to 1 to stop a background session’s in-flight work when the supervisor stops, restarts, or updates that session’s process, instead of handing it to the…
Set to 1 to stop Claude Code from terminating background shell commands under memory pressure.
On macOS with the native installer, set to 1 to run each background session’s host process from the installed binary, not ~/.local/share/claude/ClaudeCode.app.
Set to 1 to disable the skills and workflows included with Claude Code: bundled skills and workflows are removed entirely, while built-in commands like /init…
For hosts that embed Claude Code and supply their own browser guidance.
Set to 1 to prevent loading any CLAUDE.md memory files into context, including user, project, and auto memory files
Set to 1 to disable session-scoped scheduled tasks.
Set to 1 to turn off the auto and bypassPermissions time limit and denials on critical-path removals.
Set to 1 to strip pre-release anthropic-beta request headers, the body fields that pair with them, and beta tool-schema fields such as defer_loading and…
Set to 1 to disable the built-in Explore and Plan subagents.
Set to 1 to disable fast mode
Set to 1 to turn off feature-flag fetching. Requires Claude Code v2.1.319 or later.
Set to 1 to disable the “How is Claude doing?” session quality surveys.
Set to 1 to disable file checkpointing. The /rewind command will not be able to restore code changes. Overrides the fileCheckpointingEnabled setting
Set to 1 to stop Claude Code from expanding @ mentions of files and directories.
Set to 1 to remove built-in commit and PR workflow instructions and the git status snapshot from Claude’s context.
Set to 1 to stop Claude Code from reading scripts passed to a shell with -c, such as bash -c 'rm -rf ~', for critical-path removals.
Set to 1 to prevent automatic remapping of Opus 4 and Opus 4.1 to the current Opus version on the Anthropic API.
Set to 1 so that Claude waits for the result of an MCP task in an interactive session.
Set to 1 to stop Claude Code on Amazon Bedrock and Google Cloud’s Agent Platform from switching to an older model when your account loses access to a…
Set to 1 to turn off the mounted drive prompt for paths such as /Volumes/USB.
Set to 1 to disable mouse tracking in fullscreen rendering. Keyboard scrolling with PgUp and PgDn still works.
Set to 1 to disable click, drag, and hover handling in fullscreen rendering while keeping mouse-wheel scrolling.
Set to 1 to stop Claude Code from re-reading the mTLS client certificate and key when an API request fails with a connection-level error, such as a connection…
Presence-only: any non-empty value turns it on, even 0 or false. Set to any non-empty value, such as 1, to disable nonessential network traffic: auto-updates…
Set to 1 to disable the non-streaming fallback when a streaming request fails mid-stream.
Set to 1 to send the PushNotification tool’s desktop notification even while you are typing in or focused on the terminal.
Set to 1 to disable automatic registration of the official plugin marketplace.
Set to 1 to stop Claude Code from running your Notification hooks for unanswered permission requests in sessions where Claude Code sends them to the Agent…
Set to 1 to skip loading skills from the system-wide managed skills directory.
Set to 1 to turn off the PowerShell tool check that denies the cmd built-ins rd, rmdir, del, and erase on a system path, such as a drive root or your home…
Set to 1 to turn off the automatic model switch when a safety classifier flags a request, the behavior the switchModelsOnFlag setting controls
Set to 1 to stop Claude Code from sending the structured-output output_config.format field and the anthropic-beta value that pairs with it, for an LLM gateway…
Set to 1 to turn off the critical-path check for a recursive rm whose target is entirely the output of a command substitution, such as rm -rf "$(pwd)".
Set to 1 to disable automatic terminal title updates based on conversation context.
Set to 1 to omit the thinking parameter from API requests entirely. This is a compatibility option for proxies and gateways that reject the parameter.
Set to 1 so that claude ultrareview doesn’t exit with Error: Workspace not trusted in a folder you haven’t trusted when it can’t ask you to trust it, such as…
Set to 1 to turn the ultrathink keyword off. Requires Claude Code v2.1.316 or later
Set to 1 to skip proactive auto-compaction when Claude Code doesn’t recognize the model ID, such as an LLM gateway alias.
Set to 1 to disable virtual scrolling in fullscreen rendering and render every message in the transcript.
Set to 1 to turn off the WebFetch tool. The WebSearch tool stays available. Requires Claude Code v2.1.285 or later
Set to 1 to start PowerShell tool commands on Windows directly instead of through the cmd.exe launcher.
Set to 1 to disable workflows. Equivalent to the disableWorkflows setting
Set to 1 to drop a deferred tool call whose tool isn’t available when you resume with -p.
Set the effort level for supported models. Values: low, medium, high, xhigh, or max. Available levels depend on the model.
Set to 1 to add session_state_changed messages, which carry the session’s state, to the message stream.
Accepted for compatibility with older releases and has no effect.
Override session recap availability. Set to 0 to force recaps off regardless of the /config toggle.
Set to 1 to refresh plugin state at turn boundaries in non-interactive mode after a background install completes.
Set to 1 to start a CLI session with Chrome integration on, or 0 to start with it off. Takes precedence over the claudeInChromeDefaultEnabled setting.
Set to 1 to route the “How is Claude doing?” session quality survey to your own OpenTelemetry collector when Anthropic-bound nonessential traffic is blocked.
Controls whether tool call inputs stream from the API as Claude generates them.
Set to 1 to populate the /model picker from your gateway’s /v1/models endpoint when ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL points at an Anthropic-compatible gateway such as…
Removed in v2.1.142, when the fast mode default moved from Opus 4.6 to Opus 4.7
Set to false to turn off prompt suggestions, the grayed-out predictions that appear in your prompt input.
Set to 1 to make /share save its report and the whole session transcript to a local archive under ~/.claude/feedback-bundles/ instead of sending the report to…
Selects which task-tracking tools Claude Code provides in sessions that have them.
Set to 1 to enable OpenTelemetry data collection for metrics and logging. Required before configuring OTel exporters.
Set to 1 to get the task-tracking tools on every model. Without it, Claude Code provides them by default only on the models listed under Task tool availability.
Enable span tracing (required). ENABLE_ENHANCED_TELEMETRY_BETA is also accepted 1
Set to 1 to run dangerous rm commands with no prompt in bypassPermissions mode, which removes a safety prompt for destructive deletes.
Time in milliseconds to wait after the query loop becomes idle before automatically exiting. Useful for automated workflows and scripts using SDK mode
Set to 1 to enable agent teams. Agent teams are experimental and disabled by default
Set to 1 to start sessions in Code Mode, an experimental feature. Set to 0 to keep it off, or in managed settings to block it for an organization.
JSON object to merge into the top level of model request bodies except on some requests outside the conversation, such as /model checks.
Override the default token limit for file reads, which is 25,000 tokens. Useful when you need to read larger files in full.
Set to 1 to force transcript persistence, prompt history, and claude agents registration even when this claude was launched from inside another Claude Code…
Set to 1 to force strikethrough rendering for ~~text~~ in Claude’s responses when your terminal supports it but is not auto-detected, such as over SSH without…
Set to 1 to force-enable DEC private mode 2026 synchronized output when your terminal supports it but is not auto-detected.
Set to 1 to draw mod Image elements as pictures when your terminal draws kitty graphics protocol images with Unicode placeholders and you still see an Image’s…
Controls fork mode, which is on by default and lets Claude start forks on its own.
Set to 1 to emit subagent text and thinking blocks in claude -p --output-format stream-json output, the same behavior as the --forward-subagent-text flag.
Set to 1 to send the gateway hint headers, such as x-claude-code-request-class and x-claude-code-compaction, on a custom proxy or a third-party provider such…
Timeout in milliseconds for the gateway model discovery request that CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_GATEWAY_MODEL_DISCOVERY turns on (default: 3000).
Windows only: path to the Git Bash executable (bash.exe). Use when Git Bash is installed but not in your PATH.
Set to false to exclude dotfiles from results when Claude invokes the Glob tool. Included by default. Does not affect @ file autocomplete, ls, Grep, or Read
Set to false to make the Glob tool respect .gitignore patterns. By default, Glob returns all matching files including gitignored ones.
Timeout in seconds for Glob and Grep tool searches. Defaults to 20 seconds on most platforms and 60 seconds on WSL
How many minutes background work can keep an active goal waiting before Claude Code asks Claude to check on it. Default 30. Set 0 to turn check-ins off.
Set to 0 to turn off gzip compression of Claude API, telemetry, and artifact publish request bodies sent to api.anthropic.com.
Set to 1 to hide the working directory in the startup logo. Useful for screenshares or recordings where the path exposes your OS username
Override the host address used to connect to the IDE extension. By default Claude Code auto-detects the correct address, including WSL-to-Windows routing
Set to 1 to stop /ide from installing the IDE extension. Equivalent to setting autoInstallIdeExtension to false.
Set to 1 to skip validation of IDE lockfile entries during connection. Use when auto-connect fails to find your IDE despite it running
Context size, in tokens, at which idle compaction applies to a conversation (default: 200000). Accepts a positive whole number, and anything else is ignored.
How many subagents can be running in one session before the Agent tool refuses to spawn another (default: 20).
Override the context window size Claude Code assumes for the active model.
Maximum length in characters of MCP tool descriptions and MCP server instructions that Claude Code sends to the model.
Set the maximum number of output tokens for most requests. Defaults and caps vary by model; see max output tokens.
Override the number of times to retry failed API requests (default: 10). Retrying can stop earlier on 529 overloaded errors.
Removed in v2.1.224 and now a no-op.
Number of subagent layers allowed below the main conversation (default: 3).
Cap the number of agentic turns when no explicit limit is passed. Equivalent to passing --max-turns, which takes precedence when both are set.
Cap on WebSearch calls (default: 200).
Set to 1 to spawn stdio MCP servers with only a safe baseline environment plus the server’s configured env, instead of inheriting your shell environment
Elapsed time in milliseconds before a still-running MCP tool call moves to a background task (default: 120000, or 2 minutes).
How long in milliseconds the first turn of a non-interactive session waits for MCP servers that are still connecting, in place of the default first-turn wait.
Idle timeout in milliseconds for MCP tool calls.
Set to 1 to show the terminal’s own cursor at the input caret instead of a drawn block. The cursor respects the terminal’s blink, shape, and focus settings.
Set to 1 to make /init run an interactive setup flow.
Set to 1 to write terminal output through a second non-blocking file descriptor, so a terminal that stops reading, such as a paused tmux control-mode pane or…
Limit how many times Claude Code re-sends a non-streaming request that times out. With 0, the request fails on the first timeout.
Set to 1 to enable fullscreen rendering, a research preview that reduces flicker and keeps memory flat in long conversations.
OAuth refresh token for claude.ai authentication. When set, claude auth login exchanges this token directly instead of opening a browser.
Space-separated OAuth scopes the refresh token was issued with, such as "user:profile user:inference user:sessions:claude_code".
OAuth access token for claude.ai authentication. Alternative to /login for SDK and automated environments. Ignored in project and local settings.
Removed in v2.1.160 and now a no-op. Previously pinned fast mode to Claude Opus 4.6 instead of the current default. Opus 4.6 no longer supports fast mode
Maximum length of content-bearing OpenTelemetry attributes (model responses, tool content, system prompts, raw API bodies), truncation marker included, in…
Set to 1 to write OpenTelemetry exporter diagnostic errors to stderr.
Timeout in milliseconds for flushing pending OpenTelemetry spans (default: 5000). See Monitoring
Interval for refreshing dynamic OpenTelemetry headers in milliseconds (default: 1740000 / 29 minutes). See Dynamic headers
Timeout in milliseconds for the OpenTelemetry exporter to finish on shutdown (default: 2000). Increase if metrics are dropped at exit. See Monitoring
Starting delay in milliseconds of the backoff between retries of a request that the API rejects with a 529 overloaded error (default: 500).
Ceiling in milliseconds on the backoff between retries of a request that the API rejects with a 529 overloaded error (default: 32000).
Set to 1 to let Claude Code run your package manager’s upgrade command in the background when a new version is available.
Set to 1 to enable Perforce-aware write protection.
Override the plugins root directory.
Plugin directories to load for the session, each loaded the way a --plugin-dir flag loads it. Separate multiple paths with : on Unix or ; on Windows.
Controls whether a mod reloads when its files change.
Timeout in milliseconds for cloning or refreshing a plugin marketplace (default: 120000).
Set to 1 to skip the re-clone attempt and keep using the existing marketplace checkout when a marketplace refresh can’t reach or authenticate to the remote.
Set to 1 to clone GitHub owner/repo shorthand sources over HTTPS instead of SSH.
Path to one or more read-only plugin seed directories, separated by : on Unix or ; on Windows.
Set to 1 to stop Claude Code from passing -ExecutionPolicy Bypass when spawning PowerShell for tool calls, hooks, and status line commands, and respect the…
Ceiling in milliseconds on idle waiting for background work, such as subagents and workflows, after the final turn in non-interactive mode with the -p flag.
Launch the processes Claude Code starts from its own binary, such as the background service that hosts agent view sessions, through a corporate launcher given…
Set together with CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR to choose the projects/ directory name Claude Code stores that session’s transcripts and auto memory under, in place of…
Set 5m or 1h, the only values Claude Code accepts, to choose the prompt cache TTL for the main conversation: your interactive, -p, and SDK turns, plus the…
Set to 1 to propagate W3C trace context when ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL points at a custom proxy.
Set by host platforms that embed Claude Code and manage model provider routing on its behalf.
Set to 1 to allow the proxy to perform DNS resolution instead of the caller. Opt-in for environments where the proxy should handle hostname resolution.
Set automatically in cloud sessions to the current session’s ID. Read this to construct a link back to the session transcript.
Set to 1 to start the session in restricted mode, the same as passing --restricted. Claude Code ignores this variable in a settings file’s env block.
In a wrapper script that starts Claude Code, set this to the name you type to run the wrapper, such as mytool.
Set to 1 to automatically resume if the previous session ended mid-turn.
Maximum age in milliseconds of the last transcript message for a session that ended mid-turn to continue automatically on resume.
Override the continuation message Claude Code sends to Claude when CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_INTERRUPTED_TURN continues an interrupted turn instead of resending its…
Set to 1 to keep interrupted tool calls, marked as cut off, in a turn that CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_INTERRUPTED_TURN continues.
Set to 1 for unattended sessions such as eval harnesses, CI jobs, or remote workers.
Maximum time in milliseconds that each API request spends waiting out 429 and 529 errors when CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG is set.
Minimum interval in milliseconds between checks of whether a usage limit was already lifted, while a request waits for that limit to reset with…
JSON object limiting how many times specific scripts may be invoked per session when CLAUDE_CODE_SUBPROCESS_ENV_SCRUB is set.
Set the mouse wheel scroll multiplier in fullscreen rendering.
Set to 0 to turn off Claude-drafted feedback for a session.
Override the time budget in milliseconds for SessionEnd hooks. The value is also the timeout for each hook that sets no timeout of its own.
Set the shell Claude Code uses to run Bash tool commands. Accepts a path to a bash or zsh binary, for example /opt/homebrew/bin/bash.
Command prefix that wraps shell commands Claude Code spawns: Bash tool calls, hook commands, status line commands, and stdio MCP server startup commands.
Choose between Claude Code’s full system prompt and a shorter one with abbreviated tool descriptions.
Skip client-side authentication for Claude Platform on AWS, for gateways that sign requests themselves
Skip Google Cloud authentication for Claude Models on Google Cloud (Anthropic managed), for gateways that attach the credentials themselves
Set to 1 to turn off the in-process cache of credentials resolved from the AWS default credential provider chain, so Claude Code resolves the chain on every…
Skip AWS authentication for Amazon Bedrock (for example, when using an LLM gateway)
Set to 1 to treat a failed fast mode availability check as available, for networks that block the check’s direct request to api.anthropic.com.
Set to 1 to skip the client-side fast mode availability check, for proxies that intercept the check’s request rather than refuse it.
Skip Azure authentication for Microsoft Foundry, for a proxy or gateway that injects its own Authorization header.
Skip AWS authentication for Amazon Bedrock Mantle (for example, when using an LLM gateway)
The startup model checks on Amazon Bedrock and Google Cloud’s Agent Platform remember on this machine which models they found your account can’t invoke, for…
Set to 1 to skip writing prompt history and session transcripts to disk.
Skip Google authentication for Google Cloud’s Agent Platform (for example, when using an LLM gateway)
Set to 1 to have a session started with --output-format stream-json write a result message naming why Claude Code refused to start for startup failures that…
Maximum number of consecutive times a Stop or SubagentStop hook may block the turn from ending before Claude Code overrides it and ends the turn anyway…
The default model for subagents, agent team teammates, and workflow agents that aren’t assigned a model another way.
Set to 1 to force one model onto subagents, teammates, and workflow agents. Run every subagent on one model says which model that is.
Set 5m or 1h, the only values Claude Code accepts, to choose the prompt cache TTL for requests outside the main conversation, such as subagents, workflows…
Set to 1 to strip credentials from the environments of the subprocesses Claude Code starts, such as Bash commands, hooks, and stdio MCP servers.
Sync claude.ai plugins into sessions
Set to 1 in non-interactive mode (the -p flag) to wait for plugin installation to complete before the first query.
Timeout in milliseconds for synchronous plugin installation. When exceeded, Claude Code proceeds without plugins and logs an error.
Set to 1 to make Claude Code download the skills enabled for your claude.ai account.
Timeout in milliseconds for the skills resync that runs mid-session when an app built on the Agent SDK reloads skills (default: 30000).
Timeout in milliseconds for the first query to wait for the initial skill list when CLAUDE_CODE_SYNC_SKILLS is set (default: 5000).
Set to false to disable syntax highlighting in diff output. Useful when colors interfere with your terminal setup.
Share a task list across sessions. Set the same ID in multiple Claude Code instances to coordinate on a shared task list, in sessions that have the Task tools.
Override the temp directory used for internal temp files. Claude Code appends /claude-{uid}/ to this path on Unix, or /claude/ on Windows.
Presence-only: any non-empty value turns it on, even 0 or false. Set to any non-empty value, such as 1, to allow 24-bit truecolor output inside tmux.
On Linux and WSL, set to a comma-separated list of the kinds of processes Claude Code excludes from the tool memory cap, such as mcp or lsp.
